name: My Wife
original_name: ว่าที่ภาระหย่า
overview: With Warisa desperate to find a way to save her father's business, she agrees to marry Woranit—the troublesome daughter of a famous politician—in exchange for the money to pay off his debts and keep the factory running. Can a relationship born of necessity blossom into true love, or is it nothing but deception from the start? ~~ Adapted from the web novel "My Wife" (My Wife #ว่าที่ภาระหย่า) by Salmon (แซลม่อน).
